name: Reika no Yakata ~Saimin Yuugi e no Shoutaijou~
original_name: 麗華の館 ～催眠遊戯への招待状～
source: A sudden snowstorm forces Kyoichi and his sister Hime to seek shelter in a mysterious inn. Once inside, they discover that the two voluptuous owners Reika and Hitomi operate it as a high class brothel. They use hypnosis on Kyoichi to bring him into a world of pleasure, and when his lovely sister tries to rescue him, they also use hypnosis on her! Will they be able to escape?
translation: 一场突如其来的暴风雪迫使恭一和他的妹妹姬前往一家神秘的旅馆避难。进去后，他们发现两位性感的老板丽华和瞳将其经营为一家高级妓院。他们对恭一使用催眠，将他带入了一个快乐的世界，当他可爱的妹妹试图营救他时，他们也对她使用了催眠！他们能逃脱吗？
